stories.title: The Under-the-Radar Creeks That Are Sweeping Carbon Out of Salt Marshes
stories.desc: Transport via tidal creeks is a “major and often underrecognized” pathway of carbon in the coastal wetlands, and a gap in most blue carbon assessments, new research reports.
